|quest_reward4_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Vulnerability''' is a [[hex]] [[spell]] that [[curse]]s all targets in an area, making them take increased [[physical damage]] and granting [[attack]] hits dealt on the cursed targets a chance to apply [[bleed]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''Cursed enemies take increased damage''': Because these [[modifier]]s are an increase to the target's [[damage taken]], they are multiplicative with attacker's damage dealt and additive with any other effects to damage taken on the defender. * Vulnerability can be turned into an [[aura]] by linking it with either {{il|Blasphemy Support}} or {{il|Awakened Blasphemy Support}}.[[File:Vulnerability aura to radius |c2_pattern_value = +%sm }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Related modifiers== {{Query spawnable modifiers |where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%curse_on_hit_level_vulnerability%" AND domain = 1 |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type=1 |group=1 }} ===Delve exclusive modifiers=== * {{ml|CurseOnHitLevelVulnerabilityDelve|display=verbose}} This Delve mod spawns on rings only, and can be dropped from nodes with mod {{c|mod|Contains Physical Items}}. ===Synthesis implicits=== {{Modifier table |q_tables=mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where=(mod_stats.id LIKE "%vulnerability%") AND mods.domain=1 AND mods.generation_type=3 AND mods.id LIKE "%Synthesis%Implicit%" |stat_text=1 |required_level=1 |group=1 }} ===Legacy mods=== {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%curse_on_hit_level_vulnerability%" AND mods.id NOT LIKE "CurseOnHitLevelVulnerabilityDelve" |q_having = SUM(mod_spawn_weights.value) = 0 |q_groupBy = mod_spawn_weights._pageID |stat_text=1 |level=1 |spawn_weights=1 |generation_type=1 |group=1 }} {{Skill enchantment modifier list|skill=Vulnerability}} ==Related unique items== {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where= item_stats.id LIKE "%vulnerability%" |level=1 |stat=1 |large=1 }} ==Related passive skills== The following passive skills are related to Vulnerability: {{Passive skill table |q_where= passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Vulnerability%" |large=1 |stat_text=1 }} ==Vulnerability in maps== {{main|List of map suffix mods}} Vulnerability is one of the [[curse]]s that can be rolled on [[maps]] and [[Vaal side area]]s (known as "secret_area" in spawn weight table). The [[curse]]s affect the entire area and cannot be removed. The level of the curses is fixed (level 1). {{Query spawnable modifiers |where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%Vulnerability%" AND domain = 5 |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Quality now provides Attack Hits against Cursed Enemies have 0-10% chance to Aggravate Bleeding (previously 0-20% increased Duration of Bleeding on Cursed Enemies). }} {{Version history table row|3.20.0| *Now has {{c|mod|Base duration is (8-11.8) seconds}} (previously (9-10.9) seconds). *Now causes {{c|mod|Cursed enemies take ('''15-30''')% increased Physical Damage}} (previously (30-39)%). *Now causes {{c|mod|Attacks Hits against Cursed Enemies have '''25%''' chance to inflict Bleeding}} (previously 20%). *No longer causes {{c|mod|Ailments inflicted on Cursed Enemies deal Damage 20% Faster}}. *Quality no longer grants {{c|mod|Attack Hits against Cursed Enemies have 0-10% chance to inflict Bleeding}}. **Instead, it grants {{c|mod|(0-10)% increased Duration of Bleeding on Cursed Enemies}}. }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0f| * Map Curse modifiers no longer have increased effect. }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| ''All curse skills have been reworked and are now divided into two categories: Hexes and Marks.'' * No longer causes attack hits to have a chance to Maim cursed enemies. * No longer causes cursed enemies to take increased physical damage from damage over time. * Curses applied by casting this spell now gain 10 Doom per second. * Now causes ailments inflicted on cursed enemies to deal damage 20% faster. }} {{Version history table row|3.6.0| * Mana Cost at gem level 1 is now 16 (was 24) * Mana Cost at gem level 20 is now 33 (was 50) }} {{Version history table row|3.1.2| * Fixed a bug where the Vulnerability aura used in the Doedre encounters in Act 4, the Core map, and the Phantasmagoria map were still applying the older version of Vulnerability. }} {{Version history table row|3.1.0| * Vulnerability has been split into two skill gems - Vulnerability and {{il|Despair}}. Vulnerability is now a Strength gem, focused on [[Physical Damage]], [[Bleed]] and [[Maim]]. }} {{Version history table row|2.6.0| * Increased Area of Effect mod and its progression per level doubled. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * Mana cost reduced at all levels. Area of effect increases per gem level reduced, but the base area of effect has been increased by 37.5% (from 16 to 22). Normalised the increased duration per gem level. }} {{Version history table row|1.2.0| * In addition to the general curse reduction, Vulnerability no longer affects Energy Shield. The Energy Shield Recharge Delay Increase and Energy Shield Recharge Rate Reduction stats have been removed. In addition, the Increased Chance to be Stunned and Reduced Enemy Stun Recovery stats have been removed as well. Vulnerability now only increases physical damage and degeneration damage. }} {{Version history table row|1.1.0| * Physical damage taken changed from "more" to "increased". {{Undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|0.9.13b| * The additional chance to be stunned now works correctly. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.5g| * Fixed Vulnerability not being affected by the [[Hex Master]] keystone passive. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.2| * Added new skill prototype - "Vulnerability": Curses all targets in an area, making them take increased damage from physical attacks and degeneration, and easier to stun. The target's energy shield will regenerate more slowly. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist|refs= {{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=April 16, 2014|title=Vulnerability Quality|url=http://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/891571/page/1#p7610912|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums|accessdate=April 16, 2014}} }} {{Navbox Skills}} {{sister|poe2wiki}}
